top_signals.title: BTW: Headlines You May Have Missed
top_signals.summary: LinkedIn becoming a dating site, ghost jobs, fun at home, and farmers saying no to data centers: Alexis Christoforous joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines from this week that may have gone under the radar. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
